does: Scores for the AI standing on one AI-grid tile: height, collision and floating checks on the tile, the surface the character would stand in, then the detailed position score of CalculatePositionScore2.

evidence.says: returns an AiScore for an AiTilePos, character, position and PositionScoreOptions; calls eoc::AiGrid::ToTilePos, IsColliding, GetHeightAtTile, eoc::IsFloating, CalculateAiScoreSurfaceOnObject and, about 15 000 times, CalculatePositionScore2
A counter on every function over a play of the prologue shows it called only while a fight was on, from 18 places in the AI decision code
EoCServer.dll exports this name; it is tied to this function by the job its read shows
